post.summary: Fill missing exchanges for up to five explicitly selected securities; preserve existing assignments.
post.description:
Authenticated, explicit mutation. Reads names and tickers from the database, not from client assertions. Checks local records, then exact Yahoo search and listing metadata; optional Sonar discovery requires PERPLEXITY_API_KEY and still requires independent listing validation. Ambiguous listings, identity conflicts, missing tickers, changed records and provider failures remain review results. Each successful security and its matching live references update in a transaction. No automatic identity merges or historical/financial writes. Concurrent batches return 409. A 200 response may contain partial success. No request retries; a repeat skips already-qualified records. Maximum five items keeps the request bounded; clients may submit successive batches.

Selected request/response contract; workflow constraints still require handler validation.
